Dear Meghana,
 
Greetings !
 
Kindly note, we are working on a very prospective query for USA(03nts nyc+03nts vegas+02nts los Angeles) as per attached itinerary flow and below details. We request you to kindly go through the same and advise your suggestions  in the itinerary along with break up costing accordingly.
 
No of Pax: 55-60
Dates: 20th to 30th November
Duration : 8 Nights & 9 Days(03nts nyc+03nts vegas+02nts los Angeles).
Hotel-5* on single occupancy with 02-03 Indian items at brfst with Masala chai if possible.
 
Meals : High end Indian Restaurants with below configuration
o    Breakfast : Indian items to be made available at all breakfasts. At least 2 to 3 items / breakfast.
o    Lunch : 2+2 starters+02 desserts with free flow of beers ( Multiple beer options in all lunches. Beer Brands should change day wise )
o    Cocktail dinners : 3+3 starters with free flow of liquor ( Glen or above category brands. Minimum 2 hours and above / dinner ). Wine should be considered in package.
o    Gala Dinner: 04+04 starters, main course with free flow of liquor ( Glen or above category brands. Minimum 2 hours and above / dinner ). Wine should be considered in package.
o    Menu : Should be curated day wise with no repetition of main course or starters. Secluded space to be considered at all venues for our group.
 
Apart from the attached itinerary suggestion, :
o    We will stick to the same and would also like to hear from you for any further suggestions if any.
o   We are looking forward to a night’s dinner in Los Angeles to be done at Recommended Michelin Star restaurant.
 
Please include the below services while you share the quote:
·         Four 500 ml water bottles per person per day in all transfers as well as in the hotel room
·         Please note the guide on ground should be an English speaking guide only
·         FOC policy
·         All tours and transfers to be in deluxe AC coach. 
 
Thanks & Regards,
